'''Mountain trolls''' can be found in the [[troll cave]] beneath [[Well (Taverley)|Taverley well]], accessible after the [[Wolf Whistle]] quest. They are much weaker than other mountain trolls, and thus are a good way for new players to complete [[Trolls (Slayer assignment)|troll Slayer assignments]]. High level players will however find trolls in the [[Burthorpe Troll Cave]] to be faster.
